name: royal-bistro-restaurant-management
description: Hệ thống Quản lý Nhà hàng & Gọi món (Fullstack: Node.js Express + MongoDB & React Vite)

scripts.install:all: cd BE && npm install && cd ../FE && npm install
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['node_modules','BE/node_modules','FE/node_modules','FE/dist'].forEach(p=>{if(fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('Deleting',p);fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}}); console.log('All node_modules and dist cleaned successfully!')"
